description.text: Objectives The program in Chinese Language and Literature provides students with basic theory and knowledge of Chinese language and to equip them with good skills in Chinese listening, speaking, reading, and writing. The program covers subjects of Chinese traditional culture, arts, philosophy, contemporary Chinese politics, and economic and legal systems in China. Students from the program will have a good employment opportunity in government agencies, corporations, media and cultural institutions or in related fields that are involved with China. Students can easily apply for further degree program in China if they plan so. Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice. Degree Awarded A Bachelor of Art is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation. Main Courses (Elementary, Intermediate, Advanced) Comprehensive Chinese, Oral Chinese, Listening Chinese, (Intermediate, Advanced) Writing, (Elementary, Intermediate) Reading Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Chinese Language and Literature at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
